content: Registry usage analytics: npm ecosystem has third-party download-stat tools (npm-stat, PackFolio) since npm itself lacks rich built-in analytics; Artifactory offers operational analytics + integrates with Sumo Logic for real-time dashboards; pattern is admins want per-package/per-consumer pull counts, trends, and which tokens/workspaces are actively using which skills - valuable admin-facing differentiator for legal ops (who's using what skill, staleness detection).
